title: Eva skill tree skin: finishing a step unlocks what depends on it
goal: In the Eva theme the graph reads as a skill tree; the Simple theme keeps the plain look
acceptance: Each node has a state shown by shape and word as well as colour: locked (a prerequisite is open), available (all prerequisites done), done; a done step "unlocks" its dependents on the next refresh, with a short transition that reduced motion removes
Only the Eva theme gets the skin; Simple keeps the plain look; every colour is a var(--…) token and the AA contrast test still passes on all combinations; no new literal colour
docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md describes the skin; the page docs/acceptance/f160-work-graph.md holds the exact owner steps for T05
Browser test: the three states in Eva dark and light, Simple unchanged, axe, reduced motion
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: A consumer skin through the component's node slot and CSS parts, from existing Eva tokens; a new token or shared component updates the style guide in the same change. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
